def loads(
    obj: str,
    mapping: Optional[Dict] = None,
    implementation: RisImplementation = RisImplementation.BASE,
    strict: bool = True,
) -> List[Dict]:
    obj = obj.lstrip('\ufeff') if obj.startswith('\ufeff') else obj
    implementation_class = implementation.value
    if implementation_class == "base":
        parser = Base(lines=obj.splitlines(), mapping=mapping, strict=strict)
    elif implementation_class == "wok":
        parser = Wok(lines=obj.splitlines(), mapping=mapping, strict=strict)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported implementation: {implementation}")
    entries = list(parser.parse())
    return entries
